faq_heading: Homes near Cloverdale Traditional: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Cloverdale Traditional catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Cloverdale Traditional home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Cloverdale Traditional, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Cloverdale Traditional?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cloverdale Learning Centre (0.5 km west), SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (0.5 km west) and Traditional Learning Academy Online (0.6 km north-west).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Cloverdale Traditional

15 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Cloverdale Traditional in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Cloverdale Learning Centre, 0.5 km away, and the farthest on this list is Latimer Road Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Cloverdale Catholic School (0.9 km); the nearest independent school is Traditional Learning Academy Online (0.6 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Martha Currie Elementary (1.2 km). Other elementary schools close by: Cloverdale Catholic School (0.9 km north-west), Martha Currie Elementary (1.2 km east), George Greenaway Elementary (1.5 km north-west), Don Christian Elementary (1.8 km north-east), Sunrise Ridge Elementary (1.9 km north-east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Cloverdale Catholic School, 0.9 km north-west of Cloverdale Traditional.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Cloverdale Traditional

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Cloverdale Traditional can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Cloverdale Traditional are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
